proof_body:
by
  intro f z a u v hf ha
  have h := hf.complexToReal_fderiv.fderiv
  have hu : fderiv ℝ f z u = a * u := by rw [h]; simp
  have hv : fderiv ℝ f z v = a * v := by rw [h]; simp
  have hi : inner ℝ (a * u) (a * v) = ‖a‖ ^ 2 * inner ℝ u v := by
    simp only [Complex.inner, map_mul, Complex.sq_norm]
    have : a * v * ((starRingEnd ℂ) a * (starRingEnd ℂ) u) = ((Complex.normSq a : ℝ) : ℂ) * (v * (starRingEnd ℂ) u) := by
      rw [Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]; ring
    rw [this, Complex.re_ofReal_mul]
  have ha' : ‖a‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr ha
  unfold InnerProductGeometry.angle
  rw [hu, hv, hi, norm_mul, norm_mul]
  congr 1
  have : ‖a‖ ^ 2 * inner ℝ u v / (‖a‖ * ‖u‖ * (‖a‖ * ‖v‖)) = (‖a‖ ^ 2 * inner ℝ u v) / (‖a‖ ^ 2 * (‖u‖ * ‖v‖)) := by
    congr 1; ring
  rw [this, mul_div_mul_left _ _ (pow_ne_zero 2 ha')]
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z a u v : ℂ), HasDerivAt f a z → a ≠ 0 → InnerProductGeometry.angle (fderiv ℝ f z u) (fderiv ℝ f z v) = InnerProductGeometry.angle u v
